lines.zh: 我在虚空里游，像鱼贴着黑水。
lines.en: I swim the void like a fish hugging black water.

lines.zh: 身下的节段一节节亮起。
lines.en: The segments beneath me light one by one.

lines.zh: 末地石在我身边碎成粉末。
lines.en: End stone crumbles to dust beside me.

lines.zh: 我钻过现实的缝，缝会自己合上。
lines.en: I bore through a seam in reality; it closes behind.

lines.zh: 这条隧道没有尽头，也没有起点。
lines.en: This tunnel has no end and no beginning.

lines.zh: 每摆一次尾，星辰就偏一寸。
lines.en: Each tail sweep shifts the stars an inch.

lines.zh: 虚空没有上下，我只好往前。
lines.en: The void has no up or down; I just go forward.

lines.zh: 我贴着岛屿边缘游，等猎物探头。
lines.en: I glide by island edges, waiting for prey to peek.

lines.zh: 身体的环，一圈圈碾过黑暗。
lines.en: Rings of my body grind through the dark.

lines.zh: 别站在浮岛边，我会从下面上来。
lines.en: Do not stand at the island's edge; I rise from below.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，末影人三天不敢来。
lines.en: Where I pass, endermen stay away three days.

lines.zh: 传送门在身后张开，又咬住自己的尾巴。
lines.en: A portal opens behind and bites its own tail.

lines.zh: 我不需要空气，只需要一条能钻的缝。
lines.en: I need no air, only a seam to drill.

lines.zh: 这条路的尽头，是另一条路。
lines.en: The end of this road is another road.
These lands answer to me.
Dust is mine. Earth is mine.
My chest is a war drum.
Another fool wanders in.
Kings do not run; kings close in.
Even the wind steps aside.
Hear that rumble? That is my greeting.
Who dares count my steps?
Old glory crunches underfoot.
Patrol is my oldest habit.

lines.zh: 我盘在虚空里，像一圈黑色的城墙。
lines.en: I coil in the void like a black wall.

lines.zh: 头顶的末地城，离我太远了。
lines.en: The End city overhead is far beyond me.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的节段，数到一半就忘了。
lines.en: I count my segments and forget halfway.

lines.zh: 水晶还没长齐，先等一等。
lines.en: The crystals are not grown; I will wait.

lines.zh: 虚空安静得能听见自己钻洞。
lines.en: The void is so quiet I hear my own drilling.

lines.zh: 那个叫神秘蠕虫的东西，还在我胃里。
lines.en: That thing called Mystery Worm is still in my gut.

lines.zh: 我把头垂下去，看没有底的深处。
lines.en: I lower my head toward the bottomless deep.

lines.zh: 末影螨在远处爬，太小了，不够一口。
lines.en: An endermite crawls far off, too small for a bite.

lines.zh: 我的身体记得上一次分裂。
lines.en: My body remembers the last time it split.

lines.zh: 虚空不欢迎我，也不赶我走。
lines.en: The void neither welcomes nor expels me.

lines.zh: 我吐出一颗水晶，它绕着我不肯走。
lines.en: I spit out a crystal; it circles, unwilling to leave.

lines.zh: 沉在下面的旧骨头，是上一个我。
lines.en: Old bones below belong to a previous me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转圈，把黑暗搅成漩涡。
lines.en: I turn slowly, stirring the dark into a whirl.

lines.zh: 猎物总以为不动就安全。
lines.en: Prey always thinks stillness means safety.

lines.zh: 这是我的领地，我的沉默。
lines.en: My realm. My silence.
Dust settles on my shoulders.
They say I sleep? Absurd.
Who dimmed the light?
The clouds pass. Again.
Boredom is the only foe left.
I dreamed another war.

lines.zh: 我在数末地石上的裂缝。
lines.en: I am counting cracks in the end stone.

lines.zh: 虚空下面，还有东西在动。
lines.en: Something still stirs beneath the void.
Silence is also a command.
The throne feels cold.
I weigh whether to bother moving.
That nap lasted three centuries.
Let me count my trophies.
Someone is watching me, surely.
Time is politely slow with me.

lines.zh: 你站在浮岛边，胆子不小。
lines.en: You stand at the island's edge; bold of you.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的那团虫子。
lines.en: I recognize the worm in your hand.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我也在量你的长度。
lines.en: You look at me; I measure how long you are.

lines.zh: 活人的气味，从这么远也刺鼻。
lines.en: Living smell stings even from this distance.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我动起来比眨眼快。
lines.en: Do not blink; I move faster than a blink.

lines.zh: 你的传送门，逃不出我的钻进。
lines.en: Your portal cannot escape my burrowing.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下绕了一圈，感觉到了吗？
lines.en: I circled beneath you; did you feel it?
Those elytra will not outfly me.

lines.zh: 末地的风把你的披风吹向我。
lines.en: The End wind blows your cloak toward me.

lines.zh: 你是我这几百年见过最亮的点心。
lines.en: You are the brightest snack in centuries.
Here comes another challenger.
Lift your eyes. Let me see you.
So far away? Afraid?
Looking for me? You found me.
So small, standing before me.
You want the throne too?
Stop shaking. Find your footing.
I remember your scent.
Your name will not matter.
These eyes have seen many of you.
Do not look away. That is courtesy.
You brought a blade. Good.

lines.zh: 砍在节段上，像砍断一截绳子。
lines.en: A cut on a segment is like cutting rope.
That segment went dark; I still move.

lines.zh: 只有头会疼，记住这一点。
lines.en: Only the head hurts; remember that.

lines.zh: 你砍得不错，可惜砍错了地方。
lines.en: Good strike, but the wrong place.

lines.zh: 我的血是紫的，落下去就没了。
lines.en: My blood is purple; it vanishes as it falls.
That made me coil half a turn tighter.

lines.zh: 节段熄了，过一会儿会再亮。
lines.en: The segment dims; it will relight later.

lines.zh: 你听见碎裂声了吗？那是我的一节。
lines.en: Heard the crack? That was one of my segments.
It hurts, but the void will mend me.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就要分裂了。
lines.en: One more, and I will split.
A scratch. Do not gloat.
Good. Now I am serious.
Pain. Long time no see.
You have angered your king.
Again. Let me remember you.
You dare strike me?
My old wounds hurt worse.
This pain is nothing.
Step back. I need a breath.
Who was behind me?
That worm's scent smells like home.
Throw it into the void, and I will come.

lines.zh: 你把虫子举高，我跟着抬头。
lines.en: You raise the worm; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我胃里的旧虫在应和它。
lines.en: The old worm in my gut answers it.

lines.zh: 别拿它逗我，我脾气不好。
lines.en: Do not tease me with it; my temper is poor.

lines.zh: 那东西是从哪个维度爬来的？
lines.en: Which dimension did that thing crawl from?

lines.zh: 你手里的虫子在发抖，我闻到了。
lines.en: The worm in your hand trembles; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就咬你的手。
lines.en: One step closer and I bite your hand.

lines.zh: 我追的不是你，是那团虫子。
lines.en: I am not chasing you, but that clump of worms.

lines.zh: 吞下它，我就能再睡一百年。
lines.en: Swallow it, and I can sleep another century.
That scent belongs to older days.
I know this temptation well.
It glows like a promise.
Give it, and I spare your life.
Do not touch it. It is mine.
Your offerings cannot sway me.
Treasure delivered to my door.
That light speaks to me.
That thing looks familiar.
Is that an offering for me?

lines.zh: 你撞在我的节段上，像撞墙。
lines.en: You hit my segment like a wall.
My scales are harder than end stone.

lines.zh: 别贴着我走，我会当你贴上来了。
lines.en: Do not walk so close; I take it as attachment.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的剑掉进了虚空。
lines.en: That bump knocked your sword into the void.

lines.zh: 我身体太宽，这条浮岛路不够。
lines.en: I am too wide for this island path.

lines.zh: 你撞得我歪了一下，就一下。
lines.en: You knocked me aside, just once.

lines.zh: 我身上有黏液，擦干净再走。
lines.en: I am covered in slime; wipe it off before you go.

lines.zh: 碰撞不算攻击，我不计较。
lines.en: A bump is not an attack; I let it pass.

lines.zh: 你退开时，踩碎了一块末地石。
lines.en: As you backed off, you crushed an end stone.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，尾巴却扫到了塔。
lines.en: I went around you, but my tail swept a tower.
One nudge, and you test me?
Move aside, little thing.
Is this how you greet a king?
Careful. I am all edges.
Do not think I will not move.

lines.zh: 末地的虚空，是我翻身的地方。
lines.en: The void under the End is where I turn over.
I advance. You obstruct.
I am the heavyweight here.
That one goes on your ledger.
One step clears you away.

lines.zh: 我们不需要配对，分裂就够了。
lines.en: We need no pairing; splitting is enough.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有第二条我这样的虫。
lines.en: No second worm like me in the void.

lines.zh: 另一半的我，被我自己咬断了。
lines.en: The other half of me was bitten off by myself.
With two heads, who eats first?

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是这条没有尽头的隧道。
lines.en: My mate is this endless tunnel.
I multiply by shattering, not by tenderness.

lines.zh: 你问这个，是不是想看我分裂？
lines.en: You ask this; do you wish to see me split?

lines.zh: 两个半条虫，会互相追着咬。
lines.en: Two half-worms would chase and bite each other.

lines.zh: 我的孩子就是我自己的一部分。
lines.en: My child is a piece of myself.

lines.zh: 虚空够大，容得下很多个我。
lines.en: The void is large enough for many of me.
By my throne, heaven witnesses.
Two sovereigns, one legend.
The wind will carry our word.
A king's request, not a command.
Keep your eyes on your king.
The rite begins. Stay silent.
Come. Swear this covenant.
An ancient rite needs only you.
Stand beside me. Share the throne.
The next age needs its keepers.
I do not pick things up; I swallow.

lines.zh: 掉下来的末地石，进不了我的口。
lines.en: Fallen end stone does not fit my mouth.

lines.zh: 那枚末影珍珠，滚到我鳞片下了。
lines.en: That ender pearl rolled under my scales.

lines.zh: 我把它卷起来，又放回岛上。
lines.en: I curl it up and set it back on the island.
Swallowing is easy; spitting out is hard.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物，我用尾巴拨回给你。
lines.en: I flick your dropped item back with my tail.

lines.zh: 虚空会吞掉一切，不必我动手。
lines.en: The void swallows everything; I need not help.

lines.zh: 捡东西是手脚的事，我没有手脚。
lines.en: Picking up takes hands; I have none.

lines.zh: 这东西太小，我连味道都尝不到。
lines.en: This is too small; I cannot even taste it.

lines.zh: 我收下这颗水晶，它本来就属于我。
lines.en: I take this crystal; it was always mine.
A king picks things up. Strange?
My fingers remember this shape.
Worth one bow of the head.
Small thing. Weighty.
It needs polishing.
Catalogued. Numbered. Remembered.
There is no surplus of spoils.
One stoop does not shame a king.
Stop looking. It is claimed.
Even the ground hides a throne.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的影子，那影子在虚空里。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow, and it lies in the void.

lines.zh: 头抬起来了，猎物该跑了。
lines.en: My head rises; prey should run.
Four crystals are already aimed at you.

lines.zh: 我不要理由，我只要一口。
lines.en: I need no reason, only one bite.

lines.zh: 你身上的附魔，闻起来很甜。
lines.en: The enchantments on you smell sweet.

lines.zh: 末地城太吵，你替它安静一下。
lines.en: The End city is loud; quiet it for me.

lines.zh: 这条虫饿了很久，别怪它。
lines.en: This worm has hungered long; do not blame it.

lines.zh: 你跑到岛上，我就把岛钻穿。
lines.en: Run to the island, and I will drill through it.
I lower my head; that is me aiming.
Beneath the void, no one can hide.

lines.zh: 你的心跳传到我节段里了。
lines.en: Your heartbeat travels into my segments.

lines.zh: 这一口，会连着你的披风一起。
lines.en: This bite will take your cloak too.
You are today's offering.
The end stone beneath you is giving way.
Your heartbeat betrays you.
Being chosen is an honor.
You crossed my boundary.
I have raised my head out of the void.
Now there are only us.
rumble. The hunt begins.
I will note your name later.
Chosen. It will not change.
My gaze is locked.
The count begins.
That is the scent of you.
That angle. Perfect.
Run. I will allow it.
A king's gaze is heavy.
Brave. Already doomed.
This fight, I have awaited.

lines.zh: 你躲进传送门，我就撕一个更大的。
lines.en: Hide in a portal; I will tear a bigger one.

lines.zh: 我咬穿浮岛，只为抄近路。
lines.en: I bite through the island just to take a shortcut.

lines.zh: 水晶跟着你，拐弯也没用。
lines.en: The crystals follow; turning will not help.

lines.zh: 你飞到塔顶，我就从塔底上来。
lines.en: Fly to the tower's top; I rise from its base.

lines.zh: 我的头一直对着你，别回头。
lines.en: My head stays on you; do not look back.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，你的鞘翅会停。
lines.en: No wind in the void; your elytra will stall.

lines.zh: 你听见钻石头的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the sound of drilling?

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，圈越来越小。
lines.en: I circle you; the circle tightens.

lines.zh: 另一个半条的我，也在追你。
lines.en: The other half of me hunts you too.

lines.zh: 你留下的珍珠，我替你踩碎。
lines.en: I crush the pearls you leave behind.

lines.zh: 别往高处飞，那里是我的头顶。
lines.en: Do not fly high; that is above my head.
I drag the whole island toward the void.

lines.zh: 你已经在我嘴里，只是还不知道。
lines.en: You are already in my mouth and do not know it.
Ahead lies my throne.
You run well.
Never turn your back on me.
The gap is closing.
I chase slowly, and surely.
One more lap, then it ends.
This lair has no exit.
Faster. I am begging you.
Dare you glance back?
Tired? So am I.
Do not hide. Heroes do not hide.
Your breathing grows nearer.
Your footsteps give you away.
You still breathe. Good.
Every corner ends the same.
My patience is spent.
Do not stop. I am not finished.
The game nears its end.
You flee like a you.

lines.zh: 这里每块石头都听我的。
lines.en: Every stone here heeds me.
My teeth close; armor feels like paper.
With this bite, your shield cracks.
I whip my head; you fly thirty feet.
I catch your cloak and drag you down.

lines.zh: 你砍在节段上，那里不重要。
lines.en: You struck a segment; that part does not matter.
A crystal bursts behind you.
I lift you in my jaws, then set you down.

lines.zh: 这一击，是头撞的，不是牙。
lines.en: That was a headbutt, not a bite.

lines.zh: 你的血落在末地石上，发亮。
lines.en: Your blood on end stone glows.

lines.zh: 我只咬一口，剩下的留给虚空。
lines.en: I take one bite and leave the rest to the void.
Do not strike my tail; hit the head.

lines.zh: 这一口没咬实，你运气好。
lines.en: That bite missed its grip; lucky you.
The ground will remember this.
Again. I am not warm yet.
Take it and stand.
Kneel before your king.
Too slow, challenger.
The next one will not be kind.
Thank me for my restraint.
Stand and receive it.
Your armor is too thin.
Missed? No. A warning.
This is a king's weight.
This blow is courtesy.
I held back a third.
A king's hand is a weapon.

lines.zh: 有人把神秘蠕虫丢进了虚空。
lines.en: Someone threw a Mystery Worm into the void.

lines.zh: 我从没有底的深处钻上来。
lines.en: I drill up from the bottomless deep.

lines.zh: 末地石开始一圈圈发黑。
lines.en: End stone darkens in rings.

lines.zh: 虚空的缝裂开了，我挤出来。
lines.en: A seam in the void splits; I squeeze through.

lines.zh: 这条虫醒了，整片浮岛都在震。
lines.en: The worm wakes; the whole island shakes.

lines.zh: 四颗水晶在我身侧长出来。
lines.en: Four crystals grow along my flanks.

lines.zh: 我的节段一节节穿过现实。
lines.en: My segments push through reality one by one.

lines.zh: 末影人抬头看了一眼，转身就跑。
lines.en: An enderman looks up once, then flees.

lines.zh: 虚空里第一次有了心跳声。
lines.en: For the first time, the void has a heartbeat.
This head is harder than the last.

lines.zh: 我闻到了新丢下来的虫子。
lines.en: I smell the freshly dropped worm.

lines.zh: 深渊翻了个身，那就是我。
lines.en: The abyss turned over; that was me.
My bones crack. Wonderful.
Whoever opened the door will regret it.
I am awake.
The old order begins again.
Look up. Greet your king.
I remember the last time.
rumble. Hear it. The king returns.
Your long night is over.
From today, I set the rules.
My bed has been cold too long.
I bring the war.
Offer your awe.
This lair, awaken.
A thousand years. Still here.
Do not kneel. Look first.
The lights should burn.

lines.zh: 念出我的名字：虚空蠕虫。
lines.en: Speak my name: Void Worm.
That sleep ran far too long.
Dust, scatter before me.
Who woke me?

lines.zh: 火在虚空里烧不久，你白费力气。
lines.en: Fire does not last in the void; wasted effort.
This heat recalls old battlefields.

lines.zh: 我从没有底的地方掉下来，这也算摔？
lines.en: I fell from nowhere; is that a fall?
The ground is harder than expected.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，你怎么弄湿我的？
lines.en: There is no water here; how did you wet me?
One swallow for one life?

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的节段炸成了两截。
lines.en: The blast cut my segment in two.
Who fires explosives in my realm?

lines.zh: 箭插在鳞片缝里，像根刺。
lines.en: The arrow sticks between scales like a thorn.
From the shadows? Show yourself.

lines.zh: 魔法的味道，和虚空一样冷。
lines.en: Magic tastes as cold as the void.
I know older sorcery than this.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，这一下更饿了。
lines.en: I was hungry; now I am hungrier.
Hunger is the one thing kings fear.

lines.zh: 雷打不到虚空，你却招来了。
lines.en: Lightning cannot reach the void, yet you called it.
That shock stood my hair on end.
The void bites me? It is my mother.
No ground here. No king either.
